edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $250,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholdings. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in the employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to the terms of those plans and programs, as amended from time to time. The Company may change or discontinue any plan or program in accordance with its terms and applicable law.
edits.name: Compensation and Benefits

edits.text: 3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Company shall pay the Executive severance equal to six months of the Base Salary in effect immediately before termination (the “Severance Amount”), less applicable withholdings. Payment is conditioned on the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims in favor of the Company and compliance with continuing obligations under this Agreement. The Severance Amount shall be paid in substantially equal installments over six months in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices, beginning after the release becomes effective, subject to applicable law.
edits.name: Severance

edits.text: 4. NON-COMPETE. During employment and for twelve months after the Executive’s employment ends for any reason, the Executive shall not, within the United States, directly provide services substantially similar to the services the Executive provided to the Company during the twelve months before termination to a business that competes directly with a product or service for which the Executive had material responsibility or about which the Executive received material confidential information. This restriction does not prohibit passive ownership of up to two percent of a publicly traded company, nor activity that applicable law protects or prohibits restricting. This provision applies only to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law; any unenforceable restriction shall be narrowed and enforced to the extent permitted by law, and if it cannot be so narrowed, shall be severed without affecting the remaining provisions.
edits.name: Non-Compete

edits.text: 5. DEFINITION OF CAUSE. “Cause” means: (a) the Executive’s willful and material breach of this Agreement that remains uncured for thirty days after written notice describing the breach in reasonable detail, if curable; (b) the Executive’s willful and material failure to perform lawful duties, other than due to physical or mental incapacity, that remains uncured for thirty days after written notice; (c) the Executive’s conviction of, or plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; (d) the Executive’s fraud, embezzlement, or material misappropriation of Company property; or (e) the Executive’s material violation of a written Company policy that remains uncured for thirty days after written notice, if curable. For purposes of this definition, no act or omission shall be considered willful unless undertaken in bad faith and without a reasonable belief that the conduct was in the Company’s best interests.
edits.name: Cause Definition
